statements.quote: We continue to ramp production, build new manufacturing capacity and expand our operations to enable increased deliveries and deployments of our products, and invest in research and development to accelerate our AI, software and fleet-based profits for further revenue growth.
statements.notes: Present-tense statement that R&D investment goes partly toward AI; no year named, so code assigns the reported year.

statements.quote: We are simultaneously ramping new products, building or ramping manufacturing facilities on three continents, piloting the development and manufacture of new battery cell technologies, expanding our Supercharger network and investing in autonomy and other artificial intelligence enabled training and products, and the pace of our capital spend may vary depending on overall priority among projects, the pace at which we meet milestones, production adjustments to and among our various products, increased capital efficiencies and the addition of new projects.
statements.notes: AI training and products are listed as one of several capital projects; the sentence gives no amount or share.

statements.quote: Owing and subject to the foregoing as well as the pipeline of announced projects under development, all other continuing infrastructure growth and varying levels of inflation, we currently expect our capital expenditures to exceed $10.00 billion in 2024 and be between $8.00 to $10.00 billion in each of the following two fiscal years.
statements.notes: "Exceed $10.00 billion" is a lower bound only; amount_high is set equal to amount_low because no upper bound is stated. This is total capex. Its link to AI comes only through "the foregoing", which refers to the previous sentence (AI is one of several listed projects), not to wording in this sentence.

statements.quote: Owing and subject to the foregoing as well as the pipeline of announced projects under development, all other continuing infrastructure growth and varying levels of inflation, we currently expect our capital expenditures to exceed $10.00 billion in 2024 and be between $8.00 to $10.00 billion in each of the following two fiscal years.
statements.notes: "Each of the following two fiscal years" after 2024 is taken as 2025. This is total capex, and its link to AI is indirect, through "the foregoing".

statements.quote: Owing and subject to the foregoing as well as the pipeline of announced projects under development, all other continuing infrastructure growth and varying levels of inflation, we currently expect our capital expenditures to exceed $10.00 billion in 2024 and be between $8.00 to $10.00 billion in each of the following two fiscal years.
statements.notes: "Each of the following two fiscal years" after 2024 is taken as 2026. This is total capex, and its link to AI is indirect, through "the foregoing".

statements.quote: The overall increase was primarily driven by additional costs in the current year related to the pre-production phase for Cybertruck, AI and other programs.
statements.notes: AI is named as one driver of the $894 million R&D increase alongside Cybertruck and other programs. The AI portion is not quantified, and the $894 million is not recorded as AI spend.
